title: Inception
description: A skilled thief who steals secrets from deep within the subconscious is offered a shot at redemption if he can plant an idea instead of stealing one.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Two imprisoned men bond over the years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

title: The Dark Knight
description: When a criminal mastermind known as the Joker wreaks havoc on Gotham, a vigilante must confront one of the greatest psychological tests of his ability to fight injustice.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine across four tales of violence and redemption.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A slow-witted but kind-hearted man from Alabama witnesses and unwittingly influences several defining historical events of the 20th century.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer programmer discovers reality as he knows it is a simulation, and joins a rebellion to break free from it.

title: Interstellar
description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity as Earth becomes uninhabitable.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family schemes to become employed by a wealthy household, setting off a chain of consequences no one could have predicted.

title: Spirited Away
description: A young girl wanders into a magical world of spirits and must find the courage to save her parents and herself.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A legendary hotel concierge and his loyal lobby boy become entangled in a theft and murder investigation involving a family fortune.

title: Get Out
description: A young man uncovers a disturbing secret when he visits his girlfriend's seemingly friendly family estate.

title: La La Land
description: An aspiring actress and a dedicated jazz musician pursue their dreams, and each other, across the seasons in Los Angeles.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search of her homeland with the aid of a group of escaped prisoners.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A hobbit and eight companions set out on a perilous journey to destroy a powerful ring before it falls into the wrong hands.

title: Toy Story
description: A cowboy doll's world is turned upside down when a spaceman action figure becomes his owner's new favorite toy.

title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
description: A couple undergoes a procedure to erase each other from their memories after their relationship turns sour, with unexpected consequences.

title: Whiplash
description: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cutthroat music conservatory, where a ruthless instructor pushes him to his breaking point.

title: The Social Network
description: The story of the founding of a revolutionary social media site, and the legal battles that followed among its creators.

title: Knives Out
description: A detective investigates the death of a wealthy crime novelist during a gathering of his wonderfully dysfunctional family.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
description: A teenager from Brooklyn becomes one of several Spider-People tasked with stopping a threat that spans across parallel universes.

title: Coco
description: A boy is transported to the Land of the Dead, where he uncovers the truth about his family's mysterious history.

title: Gladiator
description: A betrayed Roman general sets out to seek revenge against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and stole his throne.

title: Amelie
description: A shy waitress in Paris secretly sets out to improve the lives of those around her, while struggling to find the courage to pursue her own happiness.

title: Django Unchained
description: A freed slave partners with a bounty hunter to rescue his wife from a ruthless plantation owner.

title: The Prestige
description: Two rival stage magicians engage in an escalating battle to create the ultimate illusion, with devastating consequences for both.

title: Howl's Moving Castle
description: A young woman cursed with sudden old age seeks refuge in the moving castle of an eccentric and powerful wizard.

title: A Quiet Place
description: A family must live in near-total silence while hiding from creatures that hunt anything that makes a sound.

title: The Truman Show
description: An insurance salesman slowly discovers that his entire life is a constructed television show broadcast to the world.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: A young blade runner unearths a long-buried secret that leads him to track down a former blade runner missing for thirty years.

title: Little Miss Sunshine
description: A wonderfully dysfunctional family road-trips across the country so their young daughter can compete in a beauty pageant.
